62 HCW cases (64%) were part of 10 distinct clusters in non-ETU health care facilities

a review of national data and field investigations identified 97 cases of Ebola among HCWs in Liberia, 62 of which occurred in 10 clusters
Information on health care worker occupations and facilities was compiled from health care cluster investigations

methods_quotes.q: Clusters were defined as two or more confirmed, probable, or suspected cases of Ebola among HCWs
Source patients were identified prospectively in some clusters, and retrospectively in others.
